name: Enduum
summary: Enduum is an Ayleid ruin on the shore west of Camlorn in Glenumbra containing Aldmeri Dominion soldiers and skeletons. Rats and spiders and are found in ample numbers within with a squirrel. During the Elsweyr Chapter prologue quest, Daggerfall Covenant characters will be sent here by Abnur Tharn to collect dusk mushrooms for Dagaril-dro.
notes: The Dawn Era reference was noted to be an error by Lawrence Schick, and is instead intended to be First Era. This was fixed in Update 51.
